title: Determinant bounds 1 ≤ det(id + B*B) ≤ 1 + 2ⁿ Σ|Beᵢ|² for ‖B‖ ≤ 1
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ and let B : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ be a continuous linear map with operator norm ‖B‖ ≤ 1. Let det(id + B*B) be the determinant (ContinuousLinearMap.det) of the endomorphism id_{ℝⁿ} + B*∘B of ℝⁿ, where B* is the adjoint. Then 1 ≤ det(id + B*B) and det(id + B*B) ≤ 1 + 2ⁿ Σ_{i ∈ Fin n} |B e_i|², where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 is the i-th standard basis vector of ℝⁿ = Euclid n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (B : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k), ‖B‖ ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid n) + B.adjoint ∘L B).det ∧ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid n) + B.adjoint ∘L B).det ≤ 1 + 2 ^ n * ∑ i : Fin n, ‖B (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2
